translations.eng: When I heard the tragic news, I was deeply moved with grief.
translations.amh: አሳዛኙን ዜና ስሰማ ሆዴ ባባ።
translations.orm: Oduu gaddisiisaa sana yeroon dhaga'u garaan koo baay'ee na laafe.
translations.tir: ነቲ ዘሕዝን ዜና ምስ ሰማዕኩ ልበይ ሰንበደ።
translations.som: Markii aan warka naxdinta leh maqlay, aad baan uga tiiraanyooday.

translations.eng: Without a specific plan, I wandered wherever my feet carried me.
translations.amh: ምንም ያቀድኩት ቦታ ስላልነበረ እግሬ ያወጣኝ ቦታ ሄድኩ።
translations.orm: Bakka itti yaade waanan hin qabneef bakka miilli koo na geessetti deeme.
translations.tir: ዝሓሰብክዎ ቦታ ስለዘይነበረኒ ኣእጋረይ ናብ ዝመርሓኒ ከድኩ።
translations.som: Maadaama aysan jirin meel ii qorshaysan, meeshii cagahaygu i geeyaan ayaan aaday.

translations.eng: An elder leader must be tolerant, patient, and broad-minded.
translations.amh: አንድ ሽማግሌ መሪ ሆደ ሰፊ፣ ታጋሽ እና አስተዋይ መሆን አለበት።
translations.orm: Hogganaan manguddoon garaa bal'aa, obsaa fi hubataa ta'uu qaba.
translations.tir: ሓደ ሽማግለ መራሒ ዓቃል፣ ሰፊሕ ከብዲ ዘለዎን ኣስተውዓልን ክኸውን ኣለዎ።
translations.som: Hogaamiyaha waayeelka ahi waa inuu noqdaa mid dulqaad badan, calool furan, oo xikmad leh.

translations.eng: The surroundings are spinning around me and I feel dizzy.
translations.amh: አይኔ እየጨለመ ራሴን እያዞረኝ ነው።
translations.orm: Lafti natti maraa jira, sammuun koo na naanna'eera.
translations.tir: ኣዒንተይ እናጸልመተ ርእሰይ የዕዘረኒ ኣሎ።
translations.som: Aduunka ayaa igu wareegaya oo aad baan u wareersanahay.

translations.eng: After resolving the family dispute, my heart finally found rest and peace.
translations.amh: የቤተሰቡ አለመግባባት ከተፈታ በኋላ በመጨረሻ ልቤ አረፈ።
translations.orm: Wal dhabdeen maatii sun erga furamee booda onneen koo boqonnaa fi nagaa argate.
translations.tir: እቲ ናይ ስድራቤት ዘይምርድዳእ ምስ ተፈትሐ ኣብ መወዳእታ ልበይ ዓሪፉ።
translations.som: Kaddib markii murankii qoyska la xalliyay, qalbigaygu wuxuu helay nabad iyo degganaan.

translations.eng: I cannot attend the meeting today because my hands are completely tied with urgent work.
translations.amh: አስቸኳይ ስራ እጄን ስለያዘው ዛሬ በስብሰባው ላይ መገኘት አልችልም።
translations.orm: Hojiin ariifachiisaan harka koo waan qabeef har'a walga'ii irratti argamuu hin danda'u.
translations.tir: ህጹጽ ስራሕ ኣእዳወይ ስለዝተሓዘ ሎሚ ኣብቲ ኣኼባ ክርከብ ኣይክእልን እየ።
translations.som: Maadaama hawl degdeg ahi gacmahayga buuxisay, maanta kama qaybgeli karo kulanka.

translations.eng: He is bold and fearless when defending the rights of the poor.
translations.amh: የድሆችን መብት በሚከራከርበት ጊዜ አይነ ደረቅ እና ደፋር ነው።
translations.orm: Mirga hiyyeeyyii yeroo falmu ija jabaa fi goota sodaachisaadha.
translations.tir: ንመሰል ድኻታት ክጣበቕ ከሎ ተባዕን ዘይፈርሕን እዩ።
translations.som: Waa nin dhiirran oo aan cabsanayn markuu u doodayo xuquuqda masaakiinta.

translations.eng: The community welcomed the honored guests with open arms and warmth.
translations.amh: ማህበረሰቡ የተከበሩትን እንግዶች በክብርና በሞቀ እቅፍ ተቀበላቸው።
translations.orm: Hawaasichi keessummoota kabajamoo harka bal'aa fi miira ho'aadhaan simate.
translations.tir: እቲ ማሕበረሰብ ነቶም ክቡራት ኣጋይሽ ብኽፉት ኣእዳውን ብሞቕሳን ተቐበሎም።
translations.som: Bulshadu waxay martidii sharafta lahayd ku soo dhoweysay gacmo furan iyo kalgacal.

translations.eng: When spider webs unite, they can tie up a lion.
translations.amh: ድር ቢያብር አንበሳ ያስር።
translations.orm: Dallaan gamtaa waraabessa dhowwa.
translations.tir: ሓሳብ እንተ ሓቢሩስ ኣንበሳ ይኣስር።
translations.som: Gacmo wada jir bay wax ku gooyaan.

translations.eng: Slowly and with patience, sour unripe fruit turns sweet.
translations.amh: ቀስ በቀስ በእንቁላል እግር እርምጃ ጎምዛዛው ፍሬ ይጣፍጣል።
translations.orm: Suuta suutaan killeen miilla baasti.
translations.tir: ቀስ ብቐስ ብዕግስቲ መጺጽ ፍረ ይምቅር።
translations.som: Sabartaa caano macaan cabta.

translations.eng: The farmer plowed the fertile field before the heavy rain started.
translations.amh: ገበሬው ከባድ ዝናብ ከመጀመሩ በፊት ለም የሆነውን እርሻ አረሰ።
translations.orm: Qonnaan bulaan bokkaan cimaan jalqabuun dura maasii gabbataa qote.
translations.tir: እቲ ሓረስታይ ብርቱዕ ዝናብ ቅድሚ ምጅማሩ ነቲ ለምለም ሕርሻ ሓረሶ።
translations.som: Beeralaydu waxay falteen beertii barwaaqada ahayd ka hor inta uusan roobka xooggan bilaaban.

translations.eng: The merchant did not sell his teff because the offered price was too low.
translations.amh: ነጋዴው የቀረበለት ዋጋ በጣም ዝቅተኛ ስለነበረ ጤፉን አልሸጠም።
translations.orm: Daldalaan gatiin dhiyaateef baay'ee gadi aanaa waan ta'eef xaafii isaa hin gurgurre.
translations.tir: እቲ ነጋዳይ ዝቐረበሉ ዋጋ ኣዝዩ ትሑት ስለዝነበረ ጣፉ ኣይሸጦን።
translations.som: Ganacsaduhu ma iibinin daafidiisii sababtoo ah qiimaha loo soo bandhigay ayaa aad u hooseeyay.

translations.eng: The university students are studying diligently for their national exit examination.
translations.amh: የዩኒቨርሲቲው ተማሪዎች ለብሔራዊ መውጫ ፈተናቸው በትጋት እያጠኑ ነው።
translations.orm: Barattoonni yuunivarsitii qormaata bahiinsaa biyyoolessaaf cimanii qo'achaa jiru.
translations.tir: እቶም ተምሃሮ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ነቲ ናይ ምውጻእ ሃገራዊ ፈተነኦም ብትግሃት የጽንዑ ኣለዉ።
translations.som: Ardayda jaamacaddu waxay si dadaal leh ugu baranayaan imtixaankooda bixitaanka ee qaranka.

translations.eng: The patient is not responding to speech and is not breathing regularly.
translations.amh: ህመምተኛው ለንግግር ምላሽ እየሰጠ አይደለም፣ እንዲሁም በአግባቡ እየተነፈሰ አይደለም።
translations.orm: Dhukkubsataan dubbiif deebii kennaa hin jiru, sirriittis hafuura baafachaa hin jiru.
translations.tir: እቲ ሕሙም ንዘረባ ምላሽ ይህብ የለን፣ ከምኡ’ውን ብስርዓት የስተንፍስ የለን።
translations.som: Bukaanku kama jawaabayo hadalka, si joogto ahna uma neefsanayo.

translations.eng: We will transfer the remaining funds tomorrow morning through Telebirr.
translations.amh: ቀሪውን ክፍያ ነገ ጠዋት በቴሌብር እናስተላልፋለን።
translations.orm: Kaffaltii hafe boru ganama Telebirriidhaan ni dabarsina.
translations.tir: ነቲ ዝተረፈ ገንዘብ ጽባሕ ንግሆ ብቴሌብር ከነመሓላልፎ ኢና።
translations.som: Lacagta hartay waxaan ku wareejin doonnaa berrito subaxdii Telebirr.

translations.eng: The intercity bus will not depart until all passengers fasten their seatbelts.
translations.amh: ሁሉም ተሳፋሪዎች የወገብ ቀበቶ ሳያስሩ አውቶቡሱ አይነሳም።
translations.orm: Imaltoonni hundi qabattoo isaanii utuu hin hidhatin otobisichi hin ka'u.
translations.tir: ኩሎም ተጓዓዝቲ መቐነቶም ከይኣሰሩ እቲ ኣውቶቡስ ኣይክብገስን እዩ።
translations.som: Baska gobollada u kala goosha ma bixi doono ilaa dhammaan rakaabku ay xirtaan suumanka kuraasta.

translations.eng: The applicant has already submitted all verified legal documents to the woreda office.
translations.amh: አመልካቹ የተረጋገጡትን ህጋዊ ሰነዶች በሙሉ ለወረዳው ጽህፈት ቤት አስረክቧል።
translations.orm: Iyyataan sanadoota seera qabeeyyii mirkanaa'an hunda waajjira aanaatiif dhiyeesseera.
translations.tir: እቲ ኣመልካቲ ኩሎም ዝተረጋገጹ ሕጋዊ ሰነዳት ናብ ቤት ጽሕፈት ወረዳ ኣረኪቡ ኣሎ።
translations.som: Codsaduhu wuxuu mar hore dhammaan dukumentiyada sharciga ah ee la xaqiijiyay u gudbiyay xafiiska degmada.

translations.eng: Do not touch the broken high-voltage electrical cable lying on the road!
translations.amh: መንገዱ ላይ የወደቀውን የተበጠሰ ከፍተኛ የኤሌክትሪክ ገመድ በፍጹም እንዳትነኩ!
translations.orm: Shiboo elektiriikii humna guddaa citus karaa irra ciisu tasuma hin tuqinaa!
translations.tir: ኣብቲ መንገዲ ወዲቑ ዘሎ ዝተበትከ ናይ ላዕለዋይ ሓይሊ ኤለክትሪክ ገመድ ፈጺምኩም ኣይትተንክይዎ!
translations.som: Ha taabanina fiilada korontada ee go'an ee ku dhacday waddada dhexdeeda!

translations.eng: Please have a seat and drink this freshly brewed Ethiopian coffee.
translations.amh: እባክዎትን ይቀመጡ እና ይህንን ትኩስ የኢትዮጵያ ቡና ይጠጡ።
translations.orm: Mee maaloo taa'aa, buna Itoophiyaa haaraa dhangala'e kana dhugaa.
translations.tir: በጃኹም ተቐመጡ እሞ ነዚ ሓድሽ ዝተፈልሐ ናይ ኢትዮጵያ ቡን ስተዩ።
translations.som: Fadlan fariiso oo cab koobkan bunka Itoobiya ee hadda la kariyay.

translations.eng: If the Kiremt seasonal rains arrive early, the crop harvest will be plentiful.
translations.amh: የክረምት ወቅታዊ ዝናብ ቀድሞ ከመጣ የሰብል ምርቱ እጅግ የተትረፈረፈ ይሆናል።
translations.orm: Bokkaan gannaa yoo dursanii dhufe, oomishni midhaanii baay'ee quubsaa ta'a.
translations.tir: ናይ ክረምቲ ዝናብ ቀዲሙ እንተመጺኡ፡ ምህርቲ እኽሊ ኣዝዩ ሃብታም ክኸውን እዩ።
translations.som: Haddii roobabka xilliga gu'ga ay goor hore yimaadaan, waxsoosaarka dalaggu wuxuu noqon doonaa mid aad u barwaaqo ah.

translations.eng: If the ambulance had arrived ten minutes earlier, the blood loss would have been minimized.
translations.amh: አምቡላንሱ ከአስር ደቂቃ በፊት ደርሶ በነበረ ኖሮ የደም መፍሰሱ ይቀንስ ነበር።
translations.orm: Ambulaansiin daqiiqaa kudhan dura utuu ga'ee dhiigni dhangala'u ni xiqqaata ture.
translations.tir: ኣምቡላንስ ቅድሚ ዓሰርተ ደቒቕ በጺሑ እንተዝነብር፡ እቲ ምፍሳስ ደም ምቐነሰ ነይሩ።
translations.som: Haddii ambalaastu ay imaan lahayd toban daqiiqo ka hor, dhiig-baxu wuu yaraan lahaa.

translations.eng: Why has the distribution of subsidized edible oil been delayed this month?
translations.amh: በዚህ ወር የተደጎመው የምግብ ዘይት ስርጭት ለምን ዘገየ?
translations.orm: Ji'a kana raabsiin zayita nyaataa deeggersa mootummaa qabu maaliif ture?
translations.tir: ኣብዚ ወርሒ እዚ ናይቲ ድጎማ ዝተገብረሉ ናይ መግቢ ዘይቲ ዕደላ ስለምንታይ ደንጒዩ?
translations.som: Maxaa keenay in bishan uu dib u dhaco qaybinta saliidda cuntada ee la kabo?

translations.eng: Where is the nearest primary health center that administers rabies vaccines?
translations.amh: የእብድ ውሻ በሽታ መከላከያ ክትባት የሚሰጠው በአቅራቢያ የሚገኘው የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ጤና ጣቢያ የት ነው?
translations.orm: Buufanni fayyaa sadarkaa duraa kan talaallii dhukkuba saree marattuu kennu inni dhihoo eessa jira?
translations.tir: ናይ ዕቡድ ከልቢ መኸተሚ ክታበት ዝህብ ኣብ ቀረባ ዝርከብ ቀዳማይ ብርኪ ጥዕና ማእኸል ኣበይ ኣሎ?
translations.som: Halkeed bay ku taallaa xarunta caafimaadka aasaasiga ah ee kuugu dhow ee bixisa tallaalka cudurka raabiyada?

translations.eng: Would you like me to bring you another cup of spiced tea, honorable sir?
translations.amh: ክቡር ሆይ፣ ሌላ ተጨማሪ ኩባያ ቅመም ያለበት ሻይ ላምጣልዎት?
translations.orm: Kabajamaa koo, siinii shaayii urgooftuu qabu kan biraa siif haa fiduu?
translations.tir: ክቡር ኣይተ፡ ካልእ ተወሳኺ ኩባያ ቅመም ዘለዎ ሻሂ ከምጽኣልኩም ዶ?
translations.som: Mudane qaddarin leh, ma doonaysaa inaan kuu keeno koob kale oo shaaha xawaashka leh ah?

translations.eng: All motorcycle drivers must wear safety helmets and carry their valid licenses.

translations.eng: Take two tablets twice daily after meals.
translations.amh: ከምግብ በኋላ በቀን ሁለት ጊዜ ሁለት ኪኒን ይውሰዱ።
translations.orm: Nyaata booda guyyaatti yeroo lama kiniinii lama fudhadhaa.
translations.tir: ድሕሪ ምግቢ ኣብ መዓልቲ ክልተ ግዜ ክልተ ከኒና ውሰዱ።
translations.som: Qaado laba kaniini maalin kasta laba jeer cuntada ka dib.

translations.eng: Drink plenty of clean fluids and oral rehydration salts.
translations.amh: ብዙ ንጹህ ፈሳሽ እና የውሃና የጨው መተኪያ ፈሳሽ ይጠጡ።
translations.orm: Dhangala'oo qulqulluu fi ashaboo reehayidireeshinii baay'ee dhugaa.
translations.tir: ብዙሕ ንጹህ ፈሳስን ናይ ጨውን ማይን መተካእታ መስተ ስተዩ።
translations.som: Cab dareere badan oo nadiif ah iyo milixda fuuq-celinta afka.

translations.eng: Do not stop taking the antibiotics before completing the full course.
translations.amh: የታዘዘልዎትን ጸረ-ተህዋሲያን መድሃኒት ሳያጠናቅቁ በፍጹም እንዳያቋርጡ።
translations.orm: Qoricha farra-baakteeriyaa kana utuu hin xumurin addaan hin kutinaa.
translations.tir: ነዚ ፀረ-ተህዋስያን መድሃኒት ከይወድእኩም ፈጺምኩም ኣይተቋርጽዎ።
translations.som: Ha joojin qaadashada daawada antibiyootikada ka hor inta aadan dhammaysan koorsada buuxda.

translations.eng: Apply this ointment to the affected skin area every morning and evening.
translations.amh: ይህንን ቅባት በታመመው ቆዳ ላይ በየቀኑ ጥዋትና ማታ ይቀቡት።
translations.orm: Dhadhaa qorichaa kana gogaa miidhame irratti ganamaa fi galgala dibaa.
translations.tir: ነዚ ቅባእ መድሃኒት ኣብቲ ዝተጎድአ ቆርበትኩም ንግሆን ምሸትን ተለኸይዎ።
translations.som: Marsi cadarkan qaybta maqaarka ee xanuunaysa subax iyo galab kasta.

translations.eng: Return to the emergency clinic immediately if the fever exceeds 39 degrees.
translations.amh: ትኩሳቱ ከ39 ዲግሪ በላይ ከፍ ካለ ወዲያውኑ ወደ ድንገተኛ ክሊኒክ ይመለሱ።
translations.orm: Ho'i qaamaa digrii 39 ol yoo ta'e hatattamaan gara kilinika ariifachiisaatti deebi'aa.
translations.tir: ረስኒ ካብ 39 ዲግሪ ንላዕሊ እንተደኣ ደይቡ ቀጥታ ናብ ህጹጽ ሕክምና ተመለሱ።

translations.amh: በጅግጅጋ ማዘጋጃ ቤት የግብር ከፋይ መለያ ቲን ሰርተፍኬት ለማደስ ምን አይነት የተረጋገጡ ሰነዶች ያስፈልጋሉ?
translations.orm: Bulchiinsa magaalaa Jigjigaatti sartafikeetii kaffalaa gibiraa lakkoofsa TIN haaromsuuf sanadoonni mirkanaa'an akkamii barbaachisu?
translations.tir: ኣብ ምምሕዳር ከተማ ጅግጅጋ ናይ ግብሪ ከፋሊ መለለዪ ቲን ወረቐት ንምሕዳስ እንታይ ዓይነት ዝተረጋገጹ ሰነዳት የድልዩ?
translations.som: Waa maxay dukumentiyada la xaqiijiyay ee looga baahan yahay in lagu cusboonaysiiyo shahaadada cashuur-bixiyaha ee lambarka TIN dawladda hoose ee Jigjiga?

translations.amh: በአክሱም ማዘጋጃ ቤት የግብር ከፋይ መለያ ቲን ሰርተፍኬት ለማደስ ምን አይነት የተረጋገጡ ሰነዶች ያስፈልጋሉ?
translations.orm: Bulchiinsa magaalaa Aksumtti sartafikeetii kaffalaa gibiraa lakkoofsa TIN haaromsuuf sanadoonni mirkanaa'an akkamii barbaachisu?
translations.tir: ኣብ ምምሕዳር ከተማ ኣኽሱም ናይ ግብሪ ከፋሊ መለለዪ ቲን ወረቐት ንምሕዳስ እንታይ ዓይነት ዝተረጋገጹ ሰነዳት የድልዩ?

translations.eng: What certified documents are required to renew a taxpayer identification TIN certificate at the Lalibela municipality?
translations.amh: በላሊበላ ማዘጋጃ ቤት የግብር ከፋይ መለያ ቲን ሰርተፍኬት ለማደስ ምን አይነት የተረጋገጡ ሰነዶች ያስፈልጋሉ?
translations.orm: Bulchiinsa magaalaa Laallibalaatti sartafikeetii kaffalaa gibiraa lakkoofsa TIN haaromsuuf sanadoonni mirkanaa'an akkamii barbaachisu?
translations.tir: ኣብ ምምሕዳር ከተማ ላሊበላ ናይ ግብሪ ከፋሊ መለለዪ ቲን ወረቐት ንምሕዳስ እንታይ ዓይነት ዝተረጋገጹ ሰነዳት የድልዩ?
translations.som: Waa maxay dukumentiyada la xaqiijiyay ee looga baahan yahay in lagu cusboonaysiiyo shahaadada cashuur-bixiyaha ee lambarka TIN dawladda hoose ee Lalibela?

translations.eng: I arrived safely at the regional hospital.
translations.amh: እኔ በሰላም ወደ ክልሉ ሆስፒታል ደረሰ።
translations.orm: Ani nagaan hospitaala naannichaa ga'e.
translations.tir: ኣነ ብደሓን ናብቲ ናይ ዞባ ሆስፒታል በጽሐ።
translations.som: Anigu si nabad ah ku gaaray cusbitaalka gobolka.

translations.eng: I did not arrive at the regional hospital on time.
translations.amh: እኔ በሰዓቱ ወደ ክልሉ ሆስፒታል አልደረሰም።
translations.orm: Ani yeroon gara hospitaala naannichaatti hin geenye.
translations.tir: ኣነ ብግዜኡ ናብቲ ናይ ዞባ ሆስፒታል ኣይበጽሐን።
translations.som: Anigu waqtigii loogu talagalay ma gaarin cusbitaalka gobolka.

translations.eng: I is traveling toward the regional hospital.
translations.amh: እኔ ወደ ክልሉ ሆስፒታል እየተጓዘ ነው።
translations.orm: Ani gara hospitaala naannichaatti imalaa jira.
translations.tir: ኣነ ናብቲ ናይ ዞባ ሆስፒታል እናተጓዕዘ እዩ ዘሎ።
translations.som: Anigu wuxuu u socdaalaa dhinaca cusbitaalka gobolka.

translations.eng: I will arrive at the regional hospital before sunset.
translations.amh: እኔ ፀሐይ ከመጥለቋ በፊት ወደ ክልሉ ሆስፒታል ይደርሳል።
translations.orm: Ani aduun dhihuun dura hospitaala naannichaa ni ga'a.
translations.tir: ኣነ ጸሓይ ቅድሚ ምዕራባ ናብቲ ናይ ዞባ ሆስፒታል ክበጽሕ እዩ።
translations.som: Anigu wuxuu gaari doonaa cusbitaalka gobolka ka hor inta aysan qorraxdu dhicin.

translations.eng: I confirmed the receipt of the money through Telebirr.
translations.amh: እኔ የገንዘቡን መድረስ በቴሌብር አረጋገጠ።
translations.orm: Ani qarshii sana Telebirriidhaan fudhachuu isaa mirkaneesse.
translations.tir: ኣነ ምብጻሕ እቲ ገንዘብ ብቴሌብር ኣረጋገጸ።
translations.som: Anigu wuxuu xaqiijiyay helitaanka lacagta ee Telebirr.

translations.eng: I did not receive the payment confirmation SMS message.
translations.amh: እኔ የክፍያ ማረጋገጫ አጭር የጽሁፍ መልእክት አልደረሰውም።
translations.orm: Ani ergaa gabaabaa kaffaltii mirkaneessu hin arganne.
translations.tir: ኣነ ናይ ክፍሊት መረጋገጺ ናይ ጽሑፍ መልእኽቲ ኣይበጽሖን።
translations.som: Anigu ma helin fariinta qoraalka ah ee xaqiijinta lacag-bixinta.

translations.eng: I is currently verifying the transaction on the mobile banking app.
translations.amh: እኔ አሁን የባንክ ዝውውሩን በስልክ መተግበሪያው ላይ እያረጋገጠ ነው።
translations.orm: Ani yeroo ammaa appilikeeshinii baankiitiin dabarsa sana mirkaneessaa jira.
translations.tir: ኣነ ሕጂ ነቲ ምስግጋር ገንዘብ ብሞባይል ባንኪ የረጋግጽ ኣሎ።
translations.som: Anigu hadda wuxuu ku xaqiijinayaa wareejinta taleefanka gacanta.

translations.eng: I will send the digital receipt immediately after transfer.
translations.amh: እኔ ዝውውሩ እንደተጠናቀቀ ወዲያውኑ ዲጂታል ደረሰኙን ይልካል።
translations.orm: Ani dabarsi erga xumuramee booda hatattamaan nagahee dijitaalaa ni erga.
translations.tir: ኣነ እቲ ምትሕልላፍ ምስ ተወድአ ቀጥታ ዲጂታል ቅብሊት ክሰድድ እዩ።
translations.som: Anigu wuxuu soo diri doonaa rasiidka dhijitaalka ah isla marka wareejintu dhammaato.

translations.eng: I successfully harvested fifty quintals of high-grade teff.
translations.amh: እኔ ሃምሳ ኩንታል ጥራት ያለው ጤፍ በተሳካ ሁኔታ ሰበሰበ።
translations.orm: Ani xaafii qulqullina olaanaa qabu kintaala shantama milkaa'inaan haammate.
translations.tir: ኣነ ሓምሳ ኲንታል ጽሬት ዘለዎ ጣፍ ብዓወት ኣከበ።
translations.som: Anigu wuxuu si guul leh u goostay konton kintaal oo daafi tayo sare leh.

translations.eng: I could not complete the harvest before the unseasonal downpour.
translations.amh: እኔ ወቅቱን ባልጠበቀው ከባድ ዝናብ ምክንያት ምርቱን ሰብስቦ ማጠናቀቅ አልቻለም።
translations.orm: Ani bokkaa yeroon alaa dhufeen kan ka'e oomisha haammatee xumuruu hin dandeenye.
translations.tir: ኣነ ብምኽንያት ዘይእዋናዊ ብርቱዕ ዝናብ ነቲ ምህርቲ ኣኪቡ ክውድእ ኣይከኣለን።
translations.som: Anigu ma dhammaystiri karin goynta dalagga ka hor roobkii degdegga ahaa ee xilliga ka baxsan yimid.

translations.eng: I is working in the field with neighboring farming families.
translations.amh: እኔ ከጎረቤት አርሶ አደሮች ጋር በእርሻው ላይ አብሮ እየሰራ ነው።
translations.orm: Ani maatiiwwan qonnaan bultootaa ollaa waliin maasii keessatti hojjechaa jira.
translations.tir: ኣነ ምስ ጎረባብቲ ሓረስቶት ስድራቤታት ኣብቲ ሕርሻ ይሰርሕ ኣሎ።
translations.som: Anigu wuxuu beerta kula shaqaynayaa qoysaska beeralayda deriska ah.

translations.eng: I will store the collected harvest in the community warehouse.
translations.amh: እኔ የተሰበሰበውን ምርት በማህበረሰቡ እህል መጋዘን ውስጥ ያከማቻል።
translations.orm: Ani oomisha walitti qabame gombisaa midhaanii hawaasaa keessa ni kaaya.
translations.tir: ኣነ ነቲ ዝተኣከበ ምህርቲ ኣብቲ ናይ ማሕበረሰብ መኽዘን እኽሊ ከቐምጦ እዩ።
translations.som: Anigu wuxuu waxsoosaarka la soo ururiyay ku kaydin doonaa bakhaarka bulshada.

translations.eng: You (m) arrived safely at the regional hospital.
translations.amh: አንተ በሰላም ወደ ክልሉ ሆስፒታል ደረሰ።
translations.orm: Ati nagaan hospitaala naannichaa ga'e.

translations.tir: ንስኻ ብምኽንያት ዘይእዋናዊ ብርቱዕ ዝናብ ነቲ ምህርቲ ኣኪቡ ክውድእ ኣይከኣለን።
translations.som: Adigu ma dhammaystiri karin goynta dalagga ka hor roobkii degdegga ahaa ee xilliga ka baxsan yimid.

translations.eng: You (m) is working in the field with neighboring farming families.
translations.amh: አንተ ከጎረቤት አርሶ አደሮች ጋር በእርሻው ላይ አብሮ እየሰራ ነው።
translations.orm: Ati maatiiwwan qonnaan bultootaa ollaa waliin maasii keessatti hojjechaa jira.
translations.tir: ንስኻ ምስ ጎረባብቲ ሓረስቶት ስድራቤታት ኣብቲ ሕርሻ ይሰርሕ ኣሎ።
translations.som: Adigu wuxuu beerta kula shaqaynayaa qoysaska beeralayda deriska ah.

translations.eng: You (m) will store the collected harvest in the community warehouse.
translations.amh: አንተ የተሰበሰበውን ምርት በማህበረሰቡ እህል መጋዘን ውስጥ ያከማቻል።
translations.orm: Ati oomisha walitti qabame gombisaa midhaanii hawaasaa keessa ni kaaya.
translations.tir: ንስኻ ነቲ ዝተኣከበ ምህርቲ ኣብቲ ናይ ማሕበረሰብ መኽዘን እኽሊ ከቐምጦ እዩ።
translations.som: Adigu wuxuu waxsoosaarka la soo ururiyay ku kaydin doonaa bakhaarka bulshada.

translations.eng: You (f) arrived safely at the regional hospital.
translations.amh: አንቺ በሰላም ወደ ክልሉ ሆስፒታል ደረሰ።
translations.orm: Ati nagaan hospitaala naannichaa ga'e.
translations.tir: ንስኺ ብደሓን ናብቲ ናይ ዞባ ሆስፒታል በጽሐ።
translations.som: Adigu si nabad ah ku gaaray cusbitaalka gobolka.

translations.eng: You (f) did not arrive at the regional hospital on time.
translations.amh: አንቺ በሰዓቱ ወደ ክልሉ ሆስፒታል አልደረሰም።
translations.orm: Ati yeroon gara hospitaala naannichaatti hin geenye.
translations.tir: ንስኺ ብግዜኡ ናብቲ ናይ ዞባ ሆስፒታል ኣይበጽሐን።
translations.som: Adigu waqtigii loogu talagalay ma gaarin cusbitaalka gobolka.

translations.eng: You (f) is traveling toward the regional hospital.
translations.amh: አንቺ ወደ ክልሉ ሆስፒታል እየተጓዘ ነው።
translations.orm: Ati gara hospitaala naannichaatti imalaa jira.
translations.tir: ንስኺ ናብቲ ናይ ዞባ ሆስፒታል እናተጓዕዘ እዩ ዘሎ።
translations.som: Adigu wuxuu u socdaalaa dhinaca cusbitaalka gobolka.

translations.eng: You (f) will arrive at the regional hospital before sunset.
translations.amh: አንቺ ፀሐይ ከመጥለቋ በፊት ወደ ክልሉ ሆስፒታል ይደርሳል።
translations.orm: Ati aduun dhihuun dura hospitaala naannichaa ni ga'a.
translations.tir: ንስኺ ጸሓይ ቅድሚ ምዕራባ ናብቲ ናይ ዞባ ሆስፒታል ክበጽሕ እዩ።
translations.som: Adigu wuxuu gaari doonaa cusbitaalka gobolka ka hor inta aysan qorraxdu dhicin.

translations.eng: You (f) confirmed the receipt of the money through Telebirr.
translations.amh: አንቺ የገንዘቡን መድረስ በቴሌብር አረጋገጠ።
translations.orm: Ati qarshii sana Telebirriidhaan fudhachuu isaa mirkaneesse.
translations.tir: ንስኺ ምብጻሕ እቲ ገንዘብ ብቴሌብር ኣረጋገጸ።
translations.som: Adigu wuxuu xaqiijiyay helitaanka lacagta ee Telebirr.

translations.eng: You (f) did not receive the payment confirmation SMS message.
translations.amh: አንቺ የክፍያ ማረጋገጫ አጭር የጽሁፍ መልእክት አልደረሰውም።
translations.orm: Ati ergaa gabaabaa kaffaltii mirkaneessu hin arganne.
translations.tir: ንስኺ ናይ ክፍሊት መረጋገጺ ናይ ጽሑፍ መልእኽቲ ኣይበጽሖን።
translations.som: Adigu ma helin fariinta qoraalka ah ee xaqiijinta lacag-bixinta.

translations.eng: You (f) is currently verifying the transaction on the mobile banking app.
translations.amh: አንቺ አሁን የባንክ ዝውውሩን በስልክ መተግበሪያው ላይ እያረጋገጠ ነው።
translations.orm: Ati yeroo ammaa appilikeeshinii baankiitiin dabarsa sana mirkaneessaa jira.
translations.tir: ንስኺ ሕጂ ነቲ ምስግጋር ገንዘብ ብሞባይል ባንኪ የረጋግጽ ኣሎ።
translations.som: Adigu hadda wuxuu ku xaqiijinayaa wareejinta taleefanka gacanta.

translations.eng: You (f) will send the digital receipt immediately after transfer.
translations.amh: አንቺ ዝውውሩ እንደተጠናቀቀ ወዲያውኑ ዲጂታል ደረሰኙን ይልካል።
translations.orm: Ati dabarsi erga xumuramee booda hatattamaan nagahee dijitaalaa ni erga.
translations.tir: ንስኺ እቲ ምትሕልላፍ ምስ ተወድአ ቀጥታ ዲጂታል ቅብሊት ክሰድድ እዩ።
translations.som: Adigu wuxuu soo diri doonaa rasiidka dhijitaalka ah isla marka wareejintu dhammaato.

translations.eng: You (f) successfully harvested fifty quintals of high-grade teff.
translations.amh: አንቺ ሃምሳ ኩንታል ጥራት ያለው ጤፍ በተሳካ ሁኔታ ሰበሰበ።
translations.orm: Ati xaafii qulqullina olaanaa qabu kintaala shantama milkaa'inaan haammate.
translations.tir: ንስኺ ሓምሳ ኲንታል ጽሬት ዘለዎ ጣፍ ብዓወት ኣከበ።
translations.som: Adigu wuxuu si guul leh u goostay konton kintaal oo daafi tayo sare leh.

translations.eng: You (f) could not complete the harvest before the unseasonal downpour.

translations.eng: You (respectful/elder) will store the collected harvest in the community warehouse.
translations.amh: እርስዎ የተሰበሰበውን ምርት በማህበረሰቡ እህል መጋዘን ውስጥ ያከማቻል።
translations.orm: Isin oomisha walitti qabame gombisaa midhaanii hawaasaa keessa ni kaaya.
translations.tir: ንስኹም ነቲ ዝተኣከበ ምህርቲ ኣብቲ ናይ ማሕበረሰብ መኽዘን እኽሊ ከቐምጦ እዩ።
translations.som: Idinku wuxuu waxsoosaarka la soo ururiyay ku kaydin doonaa bakhaarka bulshada.

translations.eng: He arrived safely at the regional hospital.
translations.amh: እሱ በሰላም ወደ ክልሉ ሆስፒታል ደረሰ።
translations.orm: Inni nagaan hospitaala naannichaa ga'e.
translations.tir: ንሱ ብደሓን ናብቲ ናይ ዞባ ሆስፒታል በጽሐ።
translations.som: Isagu si nabad ah ku gaaray cusbitaalka gobolka.

translations.eng: He did not arrive at the regional hospital on time.
translations.amh: እሱ በሰዓቱ ወደ ክልሉ ሆስፒታል አልደረሰም።
translations.orm: Inni yeroon gara hospitaala naannichaatti hin geenye.
translations.tir: ንሱ ብግዜኡ ናብቲ ናይ ዞባ ሆስፒታል ኣይበጽሐን።
translations.som: Isagu waqtigii loogu talagalay ma gaarin cusbitaalka gobolka.

translations.eng: He is traveling toward the regional hospital.
translations.amh: እሱ ወደ ክልሉ ሆስፒታል እየተጓዘ ነው።
translations.orm: Inni gara hospitaala naannichaatti imalaa jira.
translations.tir: ንሱ ናብቲ ናይ ዞባ ሆስፒታል እናተጓዕዘ እዩ ዘሎ።
translations.som: Isagu wuxuu u socdaalaa dhinaca cusbitaalka gobolka.

translations.eng: He will arrive at the regional hospital before sunset.
translations.amh: እሱ ፀሐይ ከመጥለቋ በፊት ወደ ክልሉ ሆስፒታል ይደርሳል።
translations.orm: Inni aduun dhihuun dura hospitaala naannichaa ni ga'a.
translations.tir: ንሱ ጸሓይ ቅድሚ ምዕራባ ናብቲ ናይ ዞባ ሆስፒታል ክበጽሕ እዩ።
translations.som: Isagu wuxuu gaari doonaa cusbitaalka gobolka ka hor inta aysan qorraxdu dhicin.

translations.eng: He confirmed the receipt of the money through Telebirr.
translations.amh: እሱ የገንዘቡን መድረስ በቴሌብር አረጋገጠ።
translations.orm: Inni qarshii sana Telebirriidhaan fudhachuu isaa mirkaneesse.
translations.tir: ንሱ ምብጻሕ እቲ ገንዘብ ብቴሌብር ኣረጋገጸ።
translations.som: Isagu wuxuu xaqiijiyay helitaanka lacagta ee Telebirr.

translations.eng: He did not receive the payment confirmation SMS message.
translations.amh: እሱ የክፍያ ማረጋገጫ አጭር የጽሁፍ መልእክት አልደረሰውም።
translations.orm: Inni ergaa gabaabaa kaffaltii mirkaneessu hin arganne.
translations.tir: ንሱ ናይ ክፍሊት መረጋገጺ ናይ ጽሑፍ መልእኽቲ ኣይበጽሖን።
translations.som: Isagu ma helin fariinta qoraalka ah ee xaqiijinta lacag-bixinta.

translations.eng: He is currently verifying the transaction on the mobile banking app.
translations.amh: እሱ አሁን የባንክ ዝውውሩን በስልክ መተግበሪያው ላይ እያረጋገጠ ነው።
translations.orm: Inni yeroo ammaa appilikeeshinii baankiitiin dabarsa sana mirkaneessaa jira.
translations.tir: ንሱ ሕጂ ነቲ ምስግጋር ገንዘብ ብሞባይል ባንኪ የረጋግጽ ኣሎ።
translations.som: Isagu hadda wuxuu ku xaqiijinayaa wareejinta taleefanka gacanta.

translations.eng: He will send the digital receipt immediately after transfer.
translations.amh: እሱ ዝውውሩ እንደተጠናቀቀ ወዲያውኑ ዲጂታል ደረሰኙን ይልካል።
translations.orm: Inni dabarsi erga xumuramee booda hatattamaan nagahee dijitaalaa ni erga.
translations.tir: ንሱ እቲ ምትሕልላፍ ምስ ተወድአ ቀጥታ ዲጂታል ቅብሊት ክሰድድ እዩ።
translations.som: Isagu wuxuu soo diri doonaa rasiidka dhijitaalka ah isla marka wareejintu dhammaato.

translations.eng: He successfully harvested fifty quintals of high-grade teff.
translations.amh: እሱ ሃምሳ ኩንታል ጥራት ያለው ጤፍ በተሳካ ሁኔታ ሰበሰበ።
translations.orm: Inni xaafii qulqullina olaanaa qabu kintaala shantama milkaa'inaan haammate.
translations.tir: ንሱ ሓምሳ ኲንታል ጽሬት ዘለዎ ጣፍ ብዓወት ኣከበ።
translations.som: Isagu wuxuu si guul leh u goostay konton kintaal oo daafi tayo sare leh.

translations.eng: He could not complete the harvest before the unseasonal downpour.
translations.amh: እሱ ወቅቱን ባልጠበቀው ከባድ ዝናብ ምክንያት ምርቱን ሰብስቦ ማጠናቀቅ አልቻለም።

translations.som: Isagu ma dhammaystiri karin goynta dalagga ka hor roobkii degdegga ahaa ee xilliga ka baxsan yimid.

translations.eng: He is working in the field with neighboring farming families.

translations.amh: እኛ ወደ ክልሉ ሆስፒታል እየተጓዘ ነው።
translations.orm: Nuti gara hospitaala naannichaatti imalaa jira.
translations.tir: ንሕና ናብቲ ናይ ዞባ ሆስፒታል እናተጓዕዘ እዩ ዘሎ።
translations.som: Annagu wuxuu u socdaalaa dhinaca cusbitaalka gobolka.

translations.eng: We will arrive at the regional hospital before sunset.
translations.amh: እኛ ፀሐይ ከመጥለቋ በፊት ወደ ክልሉ ሆስፒታል ይደርሳል።
translations.orm: Nuti aduun dhihuun dura hospitaala naannichaa ni ga'a.
translations.tir: ንሕና ጸሓይ ቅድሚ ምዕራባ ናብቲ ናይ ዞባ ሆስፒታል ክበጽሕ እዩ።
translations.som: Annagu wuxuu gaari doonaa cusbitaalka gobolka ka hor inta aysan qorraxdu dhicin.

translations.eng: We confirmed the receipt of the money through Telebirr.
translations.amh: እኛ የገንዘቡን መድረስ በቴሌብር አረጋገጠ።
translations.orm: Nuti qarshii sana Telebirriidhaan fudhachuu isaa mirkaneesse.
translations.tir: ንሕና ምብጻሕ እቲ ገንዘብ ብቴሌብር ኣረጋገጸ።
translations.som: Annagu wuxuu xaqiijiyay helitaanka lacagta ee Telebirr.

translations.eng: We did not receive the payment confirmation SMS message.
translations.amh: እኛ የክፍያ ማረጋገጫ አጭር የጽሁፍ መልእክት አልደረሰውም።
translations.orm: Nuti ergaa gabaabaa kaffaltii mirkaneessu hin arganne.
translations.tir: ንሕና ናይ ክፍሊት መረጋገጺ ናይ ጽሑፍ መልእኽቲ ኣይበጽሖን።
translations.som: Annagu ma helin fariinta qoraalka ah ee xaqiijinta lacag-bixinta.

translations.eng: We is currently verifying the transaction on the mobile banking app.
translations.amh: እኛ አሁን የባንክ ዝውውሩን በስልክ መተግበሪያው ላይ እያረጋገጠ ነው።
translations.orm: Nuti yeroo ammaa appilikeeshinii baankiitiin dabarsa sana mirkaneessaa jira.
translations.tir: ንሕና ሕጂ ነቲ ምስግጋር ገንዘብ ብሞባይል ባንኪ የረጋግጽ ኣሎ።
translations.som: Annagu hadda wuxuu ku xaqiijinayaa wareejinta taleefanka gacanta.

translations.eng: We will send the digital receipt immediately after transfer.
translations.amh: እኛ ዝውውሩ እንደተጠናቀቀ ወዲያውኑ ዲጂታል ደረሰኙን ይልካል።
translations.orm: Nuti dabarsi erga xumuramee booda hatattamaan nagahee dijitaalaa ni erga.
translations.tir: ንሕና እቲ ምትሕልላፍ ምስ ተወድአ ቀጥታ ዲጂታል ቅብሊት ክሰድድ እዩ።
translations.som: Annagu wuxuu soo diri doonaa rasiidka dhijitaalka ah isla marka wareejintu dhammaato.

translations.eng: We successfully harvested fifty quintals of high-grade teff.
translations.amh: እኛ ሃምሳ ኩንታል ጥራት ያለው ጤፍ በተሳካ ሁኔታ ሰበሰበ።
translations.orm: Nuti xaafii qulqullina olaanaa qabu kintaala shantama milkaa'inaan haammate.
translations.tir: ንሕና ሓምሳ ኲንታል ጽሬት ዘለዎ ጣፍ ብዓወት ኣከበ።
translations.som: Annagu wuxuu si guul leh u goostay konton kintaal oo daafi tayo sare leh.

translations.eng: We could not complete the harvest before the unseasonal downpour.
translations.amh: እኛ ወቅቱን ባልጠበቀው ከባድ ዝናብ ምክንያት ምርቱን ሰብስቦ ማጠናቀቅ አልቻለም።
translations.orm: Nuti bokkaa yeroon alaa dhufeen kan ka'e oomisha haammatee xumuruu hin dandeenye.
translations.tir: ንሕና ብምኽንያት ዘይእዋናዊ ብርቱዕ ዝናብ ነቲ ምህርቲ ኣኪቡ ክውድእ ኣይከኣለን።
translations.som: Annagu ma dhammaystiri karin goynta dalagga ka hor roobkii degdegga ahaa ee xilliga ka baxsan yimid.

translations.eng: We is working in the field with neighboring farming families.
translations.amh: እኛ ከጎረቤት አርሶ አደሮች ጋር በእርሻው ላይ አብሮ እየሰራ ነው።
translations.orm: Nuti maatiiwwan qonnaan bultootaa ollaa waliin maasii keessatti hojjechaa jira.
translations.tir: ንሕና ምስ ጎረባብቲ ሓረስቶት ስድራቤታት ኣብቲ ሕርሻ ይሰርሕ ኣሎ።
translations.som: Annagu wuxuu beerta kula shaqaynayaa qoysaska beeralayda deriska ah.

translations.eng: We will store the collected harvest in the community warehouse.
translations.amh: እኛ የተሰበሰበውን ምርት በማህበረሰቡ እህል መጋዘን ውስጥ ያከማቻል።
translations.orm: Nuti oomisha walitti qabame gombisaa midhaanii hawaasaa keessa ni kaaya.
translations.tir: ንሕና ነቲ ዝተኣከበ ምህርቲ ኣብቲ ናይ ማሕበረሰብ መኽዘን እኽሊ ከቐምጦ እዩ።
translations.som: Annagu wuxuu waxsoosaarka la soo ururiyay ku kaydin doonaa bakhaarka bulshada.

translations.eng: They arrived safely at the regional hospital.
translations.amh: እነሱ በሰላም ወደ ክልሉ ሆስፒታል ደረሰ።
translations.orm: Isaan nagaan hospitaala naannichaa ga'e.
translations.tir: ንሳቶም ብደሓን ናብቲ ናይ ዞባ ሆስፒታል በጽሐ።
translations.som: Iyagu si nabad ah ku gaaray cusbitaalka gobolka.

translations.eng: They did not arrive at the regional hospital on time.
translations.amh: እነሱ በሰዓቱ ወደ ክልሉ ሆስፒታል አልደረሰም።
translations.orm: Isaan yeroon gara hospitaala naannichaatti hin geenye.
translations.tir: ንሳቶም ብግዜኡ ናብቲ ናይ ዞባ ሆስፒታል ኣይበጽሐን።
